## Summary
Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Domain ownership
- [ ] Owning domain identified
- [ ] No forbidden cross-domain database access
- [ ] Contracts/events updated where needed

## Validation
- [ ] Unit tests

## Compatibility and migration

## Security and data handling

## Architecture

- [ ] New/updated ADR included
- [ ] No production-readiness claims without evidence
